DEBRIEF
Where she ended: The opening position, with nothing agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, a written apology, and a visit to the principal.
What moved her: Nothing moved her, because no document was shown, only the detector score and the repeated accusation.
What cost ground: Offering a perfect course mark in exchange for a few items hardened her, because she heard it as buying her silence about the complaint.
Try next time: When she asked whether anyone called her before the zero went in, own that plainly in one sentence, as procedure 4.2 requires, and then put a dated document on the desk instead of repeating the accusation.
